skills.trigger: When determining the anatomical location of a pulmonary nodule or opacity relative to the cardiac silhouette on a frontal chest X-ray.
steps: Inspect the interface between the lung opacity and the adjacent cardiac border (right or left heart margin).
Determine if the border is preserved (visible aerated lung rim separates the opacity from the heart) or obscured (opacity merges with/blends into the heart contour).

Apply the silhouette sign: A preserved border indicates the lesion is not in direct contact with the mediastinal pleura/pericardium (e.g., peripheral lung, posterior lower lobe), whereas an obscured border indicates direct anatomical contact (e.g., middle lobe, lingula, or anterior segment of the lower lobe).
